Filter PATs by owner subject. Returns only PATs owned by this user.
Filter to a specific member by subject. Useful for fetching a single member.
Search keyword to filter members by name or email (case-insensitive).
Number of records to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.
Maximum number of records to return. Maximum 1000 when specified, but no limit is used when unspecified.
Includes additional metadata with member info, specifically created timestamp and project names.
Includes project and role assignments for each member. Required to see role information.
Includes custom permissions for each member (deprecated feature). Requires includeProjects to be true.
When true, includes totalCount in the response for pagination. May add slight overhead.
Sort order for results. Defaults to name_ASC.
